json.dataset: BenchRec cash v1.0 (Kaggle benchmarkteam, CC BY 4.0)
json.method: day-0 skill of one rule; month by month over the train history the seat decides each line, the reconciliation team's recorded match is the lesson, the evolver proposes and the replay gate accepts; each rule earns autonomy on the train months after the final version took over (the same months for every desk): suspended, and its lines sent to a person, when 95% sure its error rate is over 0.2%

rules.note: one ledger allocation on the value date has exactly this amount

versions.origin: qwen3.8-max style 0, unsupported rules removed by replay

rules.note: one ledger allocation on the value date has exactly this amount and arrived within 1 day

versions.origin: qwen3.8-max style 1, unsupported rules removed by replay

rules.note: Exactly one allocation on the value date with a second confirming signal: either uncontested or multiple ledger lines confirm the match

versions.origin: qwen3.8-max style 2, unsupported rules removed by replay

rules.note: Exactly one uncontested allocation arriving on the same day is a safe exact match
Exactly one allocation and multiple ledger lines on the value date confirm the match
one ledger allocation on the value date has exactly this amount
Exactly one uncontested allocation arriving on the same day is a safe exact match
Exactly one allocation and multiple ledger lines on the value date confirm the match

monthly.dataset: BenchRec cash v1.0 (Kaggle benchmarkteam, CC BY 4.0), locked eval split
monthly.source: the desks recorded in data/benchrec_eval/result.json; every group scored by benchrec.ts score() and scoreBaseline(); nothing re-learned, no model called

floor.test: precision >= 99.8%, i.e. wrong <= matched / 500; benchrec.ts clearsFloor uses >, which differs only at exactly 99.8%

checks: each rule's autonomy record on the train months after the final version took over equals result.json
each desk's pooled eval numbers equal result.json
the learned desk's submission equals data/benchrec_eval/submission.csv line for line
the months (by import and by value date), weeks and days each add up to the pooled numbers
monthly.monthOf: the bank line's import date (B_importDate), as in benchrec.ts

byWeek.weekOf: the Monday of the bank line's import week

bootstrap.unit: whole import days (B_importDate), drawn with replacement; the same draws for every desk
bootstrap.interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of the resampled pooled precision (linear interpolation)
